name: CSV export reviewed
goal: Add CSV export to the orders list: GET /orders.csv returns the same rows GET /orders shows, honouring its filters, with a header row and RFC 4180 quoting. Done when every item in docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md is shown to hold, `npm test` passes, and a human approves the merge.
description: A builder implements the task. A critic in a fresh context checks the diff and test output against a written checklist; failures return to the builder with REVIEW.md, and a pass goes to a human merge gate, whose rejection also returns to the builder. The loop stops when the bar passes, after four rounds, or at forty turns. Builder and critic share a tier, which the validator flags; heterogeneous-critic is the same shape with the critic on another tier.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Do the task in the code, with tests. On a later round, read REVIEW.md first and address each finding, or say why it does not apply. Run the test command before you report, and do not review your own work beyond that.
outputs: CHANGES.md: what changed this round and which findings it addresses

nodes.name: Critic
nodes.brief: Judge the change against the checklist, one line per item, citing the file and line that satisfies it or saying it is unmet. Run the test command yourself rather than trusting a report. You judge; you do not fix. Verdict pass only when every item holds and the tests pass; invalid-evidence when the diff or checklist cannot be read.
outputs: REVIEW.md: one line per checklist item and a verdict line

nodes.name: Merge approval
nodes.prompt: The critic passed the change against the checklist. Merge it?

bar.name: Review checklist
bar.acceptance: Every checklist item is cited as satisfied with a file and line, and `npm test` exits 0.
